description: This file implements the TraceState data structure and related functions for handling W3C trace context tracestate headers, including parsing, validation, insertion, deletion, and JSON marshaling.

classes.name: TraceState
classes.description: An immutable list of key/value pairs representing vendor-specific trace information, conforming to the W3C Trace Context specification.

methods.name: ParseTraceState
methods.description: Decodes a TraceState from a string, validating according to the W3C specification.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Serializes the TraceState into JSON format.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Encodes the TraceState into a string compliant with the W3C Trace Context specification.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key in the TraceState.

methods.name: Walk
methods.description: Iterates over all key/value pairs, executing a callback function.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Adds or updates a key/value pair, moving it to the front, respecting maximum size constraints.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes a key/value pair by key.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the number of key/value pairs in the TraceState.
